items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: You know, Hitler was invading all over and it looked like there was going to be a war.

ctx.x: How did you have to come back to the States?

Well, I was going to school, studying in Venice. And I had about two more years to go and get a degree. And the war broke out. And I was an American citizen and all American citizens were urged to return to the States on account of the imminent pressing state of affairs. You know, Hitler was invading all over and it looked like there was going to be a war. So that's how I came back. And I've been here ever since. What did you come to when you first got back? Well, when I first came back, I wound up in Chicago.…
And, uh, what year was that?
